snippet.title: The Sims™ 4 Sleek Bathroom Creator Kit - Official video by Syboulette
snippet.description:
#sponsored #partnership #eapartner #sponsoredbyea  #EACreativeNetwork

When purchasing my kit you can use my EA creator code: SYBOULETTE to make me earn an extra commission ! (If you buy Sweet Allure, make sure to buy it separately and use aharris00britney code !)

Thank you ⁨@electronicarts⁩ and ⁨@TheSims⁩  for the amazing opportunity !
Creator Kits will be released on the 10th of april 2025 !
Requires The Sims 4 base game & all game updates.

Some content and items used in the video requires Spa Day, LoveStruck, Home Decorator, Sweet Allure Creator Kit by aharris00britney and some of my own custom content.

Free custom content:
https://s4cc.syboulette.fr/
Subscribe for early access custom content:
https://www.patreon.com/Syboubou

You can also follow me:
On tumblr: https://syboubou.tumblr.com/
On X: https://twitter.com/SybouletteCC
On Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/syboulette.bsky.social
Or Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/s4cc.syboubou/
